## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`validating-metadata.mdx` 的「一道闸、四道门」表格里，运行时发布那一列有 12 格与规则真实的 `runtimeTypes` 不符，全部按规则重写;「Advisory」一行里三条规则在发布门的覆盖不同，拆成三行;图例补上 action、hook、mapping、datasource 四个代码。
- **为什么改**:作者靠这张表判断哪道门会拒收什么;旧格子说某些写入不被检查，实际会被拒(或反之)。
- **风险与回滚**:纯文档，一个文件，无行为改动;回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:① 表格的 `runtime publish` 列(约 L480–L525);② 表下图例段落新增的四个代码与「套件成员」一句。
- **两分钟验证**:对照 `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` 里任意一条规则的 `runtimeTypes`,看表中对应格子的上标是否按同序拼出。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

One file, `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`, the four-doors table and its legend. Every row was re-derived on `origin/main` (`89dbc745`) from `AUTHORING_RULES` in `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` (an entry is on the publish door when `surfaces` is `CLI_AND_RUNTIME`, and then its `runtimeTypes` names the types) and, for rows whose rules are reference-integrity suite members, from the member `runtimeTypes` in `packages/lint/src/reference-integrity-suite.ts` (absent = `DEFAULT_MEMBER_RUNTIME_TYPES = ['flow']`).

| Row | Was | Now | Rule(s) and `runtimeTypes` |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| CEL / predicate validation | `✓ᶠ` | `✓ᶠᵃᶜʰᵒᵛᵖ` | `validateStackExpressions`: `flow, action, hook, object, view, page` |
| Dataset measure `aggregate` | `—` | `✓ᵈᵗ` | `validateDatasetMeasureAggregates`: `dataset` |
| Ordering comparands naming a preset | `✓ᵈᵛᵒᵖᶠ` | `✓ᵈᵛᵒᵖᶠʳ` | `validatePresetComparands`: `dashboard, view, object, page, flow, report` |
| Empty filter combinators | `✓ᶠ` | `✓ᶠʳ` | `validateEmptyCombinators`: `flow, report` |
| Object & action name references | `—` | `✓ᶠᵈᵗ` | members `validateObjectReferences`: `flow, dataset`; `validateActionNameRefs`: default `flow` |
| Page-component field bindings | `—` | `✓ᶠ` | member `validatePageFieldBindings`: default `flow` |
| React page block field bindings (§10) | `—` | `✓ᶠ` | member `validateReactPageProps`: default `flow` |
| Chart bindings outside dashboards | `—` | `✓ᶠʳᵛᵒ` | member `validateChartBindings`: `flow, report, view, object` |
| Navigation vs. granted access | `—` | `✓ᶠ` | member `validateNavAccess`: default `flow` |
| `views[]` / page-component / app-nav visibility predicates | `✓ᵛᵖ` | `✓ᵛᵖᵃ` | `validateVisibilityPredicates`, `validatePredicatePathRefs`: `view, page, app`; `validatePagePredicateBounds`: `page`. The label now names the app navigation entry's `visible` (#28663). |
| Advisory row (split) | `—` | `—` | `validateRecordTitle`, `validateSemanticRoles`, `validateActionLocations`, `validateSeedReplaySafety`, `validateSeedStateMachine`, `validateCapabilityReferences`: all `CLI_ONLY` |
| Advisory: form-section layout (new row) | (in the row above, `—`) | `✓ᵛ` | `validateFormLayout`: `view` |
| Advisory: liveness (new row) | (in the row above, `—`) | `✓ᵉᵐᵈˢ` | `lintLivenessProperties`: `email_template, mapping, datasource` |

The advisory row is split rather than given one cell, following the table's own instruction ("if they disagree, split the row by the collection each id reads").

Legend: four new codes, `✓ᵃᶜ` `action` (two letters because `app` holds `ᵃ`), `✓ʰ` `hook`, `✓ᵐ` `mapping`, `✓ᵈˢ` `datasource` (two letters because `dashboard` holds `ᵈ`); the longest-first sentence names `ᵈˢ` and `ᵃᶜ`. One added sentence says a row of suite members reads the members' own `runtimeTypes`, and a member that declares none runs on `flow` writes only, so its cell reads `✓ᶠ`.

Every other row was checked and is unchanged (rule ids and types in the report on #30679).

## Acceptance notes

- **Default-`flow` members.** Three rows (page-component bindings, react page block bindings, navigation access) turn from `—` to `✓ᶠ` because their members declare no `runtimeTypes` and so run on every `flow` write's snapshot. That snapshot carries no pages or apps, so those members find nothing there. The cell follows the declared types, as the legend says and as #30669 did for the list-view and reference-integrity rows (both carry `ᶠ` for the same default); the new legend sentence says this so the `✓ᶠ` is not read as "a flow write is judged for page bindings". If the seat prefers `—` for members that inspect nothing on their declared type, that is a three-cell revert plus dropping the sentence.
- **Pair check.** A script parsed every `runtime publish` cell longest-first against the 17 codes: every cell parses, and no boundary pair between two codes forms a two-letter code (`ᵖᵒ`, `ᵖᵉ`, `ᵈᵗ`, `ᵈˢ`, `ᵃᶜ`).
- **Rules with no row (not changed here).** These publish-door rules have no row in the table: `validateComponentTypes`, `validatePrintPageBlocks`, `validatePageVariables` (`page`), `validateFlowApiTriggerSecret`, `lintFlowCredentialLiterals`, `validateFlowRegionShape` (`flow`), `validateTitleFormatRetired`, `lintSummaryRollups` (`object`), `validateThankYouRecordFields` (`view, page`), `lintConnectorCredentialLiterals` (`connector`), `validateRetiredPermissionResidue` (`permission`), `validateEmailTemplateHoleGrammar` (`email_template`). That is missing rows, not stale cells, so it is out of this card's scope and reported to the seat.

## Verification

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 43 commands for this one path (35 by path, 8 whole-tree). All 43 ran at `915a3541` (after merging `origin/main` and one whole-tree `turbo run build`, 119/119 tasks) and every one exited 0. `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` on that record: exit 0, "43 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 43 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". Docs only, no package files, so `skip-changeset`; nothing to ablate.
